formal_rule_review.locator: Rule76, printed English Gazette pages1586-1587; preserved extracted text lines4465-4578
formal_rule_review.findings: Separate country/source lower-of-tax limits; treaty excess ignored; disputed tax exclusion and settlement conditions; credit against tax/surcharge/cess rather than interest/fees/penalty; TT buying FX at preceding month end; Section206 credit separately computed and excess over normal credit ignored for specified tax-credit computation.
formal_rule_review.section160: Archived FinanceAct2026-amended Act, physical page220: non-treaty relief uses lower of Indian and foreign average rates on doubly taxed income. Do not assume this equals foreign paid tax.
formal_rule_review.corrigendum_review: Official Notification64/2026 Hindi PDF reviewed; enumerated rule edits address165,229,243 and form corrections. This is not an exhaustive later-amendment audit.

title: Guidance Note with respect to Form No.44 and Form No.45: Foreign Tax Credit
verified_findings: Guidance refers to Income-tax Rules2026 Rule76 and Income-tax Act2025, not just legacy Rule128/Form67.
Form44 records foreign income/credit and refunds of foreign tax previously credited; source-wise income, tax and applicable treaties must be documented.
Guidance states company Form44 accountant verification under Rule76(16); Form45 concerns settlement of disputed foreign tax with separate timing and verification conditions.
